BACKTEST PROTOTYPE

One year of one-minute history

The trailing 365 days of VWAP bands and four-state daily regime for EURUSD, XAUUSD, and DXY, recomputed from data/processed. No trade is taken anywhere in this view.

365 DAYS · 3 SYMBOLS
Observation view. This page recomputes the analysis engine over the trailing 365 days of one-minute history and charts where the close sat against VWAP and its bands, next to the daily regime for the same dates. Containment is not a win rate, and the window holds no entries, exits, or costs. Regenerate with python scripts/generate_prototype_page.py.

WINDOW

Band positions over the trailing year

EURUSD · 365 days

The trailing 365 days hold 370,809 one-minute bars across 285 sessions and 314 dates with bars, from 2025-09-23 to 2026-09-23 in UTC. Every session resets VWAP and both bands at 21:00 UTC, so sigma starts at zero on the first bar and widens as bars arrive. 50 sessions weight reported volume and 235 sessions fall back to the synthetic activity weight.

The close held inside the 1 sigma band on 42.6% of the 370,430 classified bars, and inside the 3 sigma band on 98.6%. The band position changed state 25,223 times between classified states. The engine writes 25,763 position records for this window, counting every move into or out of a collapsed band as one.

1 MINUTE

VWAP and bands on the last sessions

1m · 4 sessions

The chart plots the last 4 sessions inside the window, from 2026-09-16 21:00 to 2026-09-22 20:59 UTC. Each dashed separator marks the 21:00 UTC reset and carries the date its session starts on, so the bands behind it begin collapsed on that date's first bar.

Every line comes from the function the engine runs: hlc3 = (H + L + C) / 3, cumulative weight since the reset, then VWAP and weighted sigma. The chart samples every fifth bar to stay light; the engine computes every minute.

1 DAY

Four-state regime channel

260 bars

Labels come from the full daily history, then chart across the last 260 bars from 2025-10-27. Over that stretch the four states split 39% uptrend, 33% downtrend, 5% high volatility, and 23% low volatility.

Each bar carries one label, and volatility outranks trend by design: a strong trend inside a high ATR percentile still prints high volatility. Every input is trailing, so a label at bar t uses only bars at or before t.

366 dates

One column per UTC date in the window, 366 dates in all, and one row per band position of the close. Empty track means no bars that day, which covers weekends and holidays. Hover any cell for its exact count.

READ THIS FIRST

What the view is and is not

Observation mode
  • Every record observesThe engine writes action observe on every band-position and regime record. Nothing here enters, exits, or fills a trade.
  • Containment is not a win rateThe share of bars inside a band measures the dispersion of this sample, not the hit rate of a rule that pays spread and slippage.
  • Entry rules are still openThe signal combination rule decides what a 1 sigma touch and a 3 sigma touch mean before any equity curve exists.
  • The page regenerates on demandpython scripts/generate_prototype_page.py rebuilds every number from data/processed over the trailing 365 days.

Tickets behind this view: visual prototype, signal combination rule, and backtest design in the wayfinder map.
